hero.headline: Every pixel, on purpose.
hero.body: I'm Sam Stringer-Hye, an Associate Design Director at Razorfish with 14 years leading brand, product, and design systems work.

items.title: Teams
items.body: I lead teams of three to six designers, including six on the Amica.com design system rebuild.

items.title: Mentorship
items.body: I mentor designers at Razorfish and through the Publicis mentorship program, on systems thinking, UX craft, and career growth.

items.title: AI adoption
items.body: As an AI advocate for Razorfish's creative team, I built our AI roadmap, surveyed designers on their tools, and brought AI into client work, from a component audit to first-draft pages built with Claude.

items.title: Scope calls
items.body: When Amica added a ZIP-code editor after kickoff with no notice to design, I escalated it into a named scope decision with an owner instead of letting the team absorb it.

jobs.title: Associate Design Director
highlights: Leads Razorfish design teams on client work for Amica, Samsung, CVS, and Frontier, from discovery through design systems and developer handoff.

jobs.title: Senior Designer
highlights: Set the visual direction for Samsung.com's global navigation across 12+ markets, and designed prototypes and motion for SmartThings, Barclays, and Pilot Flying J.

jobs.title: Motion & Product Designer
highlights: Designed new-business pitch work for Walmart and McDonald's, and an interactive prototype for Google's editorial platform.

jobs.title: Art Director
highlights: Led art direction for Mashable's Snapchat Discover launch, and a team of animators, illustrators, editors, and producers across six channels.

jobs.title: Motion Designer
highlights: Redesigned the NowThis brand identity and built the motion templates behind its daily social video.
